pergunta: How did Jolene and her partner initially meet?
ouro: In an engineering class in college

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
[D1:2] Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
[D1:3] Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
[...]
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:25] Deborah: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!
[D2:26] Jolene: They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!
[D2:27] Deborah: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?
[...]
[D2:29] Deborah: Do you only play old games or try new ones?
[D2:30] Jolene: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.
[D2:31] Deborah: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!
[D2:32] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!
Session date: 7:03 pm on 1 February, 2023
[D3:1] Jolene: Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve.
[D3:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?
[D3:3] Jolene: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!

Session date: 7:03 pm on 1 February, 2023
[D3:4] Deborah: That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday!
[D3:5] Jolene: How did you two meet?
[D3:6] Deborah: It happened at yoga in the park.
[...]
[D3:10] Deborah: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?
[D3:11] Jolene: Well... we planned to play the console with my partner.
[D3:12] Deborah: It's also good that you have something to do together.
[...]
Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

Session date: 7:39 pm on 8 September, 2023
[D26:3] Deborah: I was bummed about it, but I'm doing better now. It was just a setback, but I found comfort in my work and spending time at home. Reminds me to be grateful for the little things. And you? How's it going?
[D26:4] Jolene: My partner and I plan a camping trip to connect with nature and practice yoga.
[D26:5] Deborah: It can be both good and tough to plan activities with a busy schedule - what strategies do you use?
[...]
[D26:9] Deborah: Sounds great! Let's set up a coffee date and talk about it!
[D26:10] Jolene: Wanna meet up at that cafe next Monday? Let's try fresh pastries.
[D26:11] Deborah: Sounds good, Jolene! When did you have in mind? That cafe rocks.
[...]
[D26:13] Deborah: That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me. Rate it!
[D26:14] Jolene: Tell me more about it when we meet, maybe next time we’ll be there.
[D26:15] Deborah: Sorry, I remembered that I already have plans for this day.
[...]
[D26:21] Deborah: Maybe just grab me some interesting books!
Session date: 2:18 pm on 12 September, 2023
[D27:1] Jolene: Hey Deb! So sorry for the late reply, been super busy. Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket. Amazing experience! Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace.
[D27:2] Deborah:  I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.

Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:16] Deborah: Take care!
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:1] Jolene: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.
[D7:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
[D7:3] Jolene: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo.
[D7:4] Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
[D7:5] Jolene: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo.
[...]
[D7:7] Jolene: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
[D7:8] Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[...]
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

Session date: 2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023
[D24:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, just catching up. I went to a cool event last week with the aim to support each other - pretty inspiring. Have you been connecting with anyone lately?
[D24:2] Jolene: Hey Deb, great to hear from you! I've been focusing on studying and my relationship with my partner. We're taking little trips to the beach, it's a great way to relax. How about you, anything new going on?
[D24:3] Deborah: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are. It made me think about how important relationships are. How about you, how are things going in that area?
[...]
[D24:11] Deborah:  It can be so freeing when you get immersed in a game like that. 
[D24:12] Jolene: Yeah! It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.
[D24:13] Deborah: What's up this month? Anything fun happening for you?
[D24:14] Jolene: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard. It's been quite stressful, but it'll be worth it in the end. Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.
[D24:15] Deborah: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.
Session date: 8:31 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D25:1] Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited!
[D25:2] Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!
[D25:3] Jolene:  It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
[D25:4] Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.
